柳生.Lv3: onTop: optional up to1 hand card to deck bottom, then draw same actual count
柳生.Lv4: onTop: optional up to2 hand cards to deck bottom, then draw same actual count; no old onDamaged or standby
柳生.Lv5: own prep standby once per turn, optional up to1 bottom-and-draw; shooting/guard main battle AT+200/DF+200

斑鳩.Lv3: onAtkWin once per game turn: consume use even if opposing gauge empty; opponent chooses1 of own gauges to discard
斑鳩.Lv4: unchanged: attack win prevents submitted defense card going to gauge
斑鳩.Lv5: Lv4 onAtkWin every win plus once per turn gauge destruction chosen by Ikaruga; consume even if empty; old noOppText removed

葛城.Lv3: onAtkWin: actor then opponent draw actual up to1 each, no turn cap; old physical AT bonus removed

雲雀.Lv3: onTop optional discard1 then draw actual up to1; no green bonus; old anti-slash DF removed
雲雀.Lv5: onDefWinChar optional any discard card1 to own deck bottom; no cap; old opponent mill removed

timing: onDamaged of departing card then onTop of newly exposed card inside applyDamage
lethal applyDamage ends game before card/character win hooks; no terminal bonus draws or recoveries added
attack card onWin then current attacker character onAtkWin; after damage
defense card onDefWin then attack card onFail then current defender character onDefWinChar
character win callbacks occur before submitted battle cards and heavy cards move; new Hibari cannot return a current battle heavy card not yet in discard
Ikaruga Lv3 selects from existing gauge before current defense card normally moves into gauge; empty still consumes use
new Yagyu returns before drawing; old Lv2 draws2 then returns1; old Lv4 leaving hook absent
standby remains existing prep interface once-per-turn flag; no extra action window introduced
draw helper does not immediately lose on drawing0; normal turn-start draw and damage loss rules unchanged

choicePolicy.parameters: cycle16 effective profiles unchanged in primary phases; no search
choicePolicy.engineConstruction: existing tune_worker.js me(profile for left character) and field(full profile map), seats balanced; inherited modeling asymmetry retained
choicePolicy.newYagyu: existing swapCandidates via 入れ替え selection title; old c_swap/c_standby retained
choicePolicy.newHibariLv3: existing optional Lv3 discard-draw selector via existing title, with no green bonus
choicePolicy.newIkarugaLv3: defender controller uses existing 本能のままに gauge-loss selector minimizing own current hand utility loss
choicePolicy.newIkarugaLv5: Ikaruga controller uses public known deck and visible gauges only; maximize loss of pool legal battle options weighted by DP (DP0 weight0.5), stable original-order tie; never reads opposing hidden hand
choicePolicy.newHibariLv5: optional interface selects1 if available; cardVal plus300 for currently defensible/heavy-usable battle; hospital +10000 only if existing c_sup_hospital=do and w_attackPass>=800; no tuned weights search
choicePolicy.rawSensitivity: replace only new Lv5 choice with unchanged generic existing picker; ability rules and profiles unchanged
choicePolicy.hospitalOffSensitivity: temporary c_sup_hospital=never in diagnostic only, same fixed30 including hospital; return selector uses that actual diagnostic profile; not a hospital-free optimized deck
limitations: solver numerical battle buffs/grantR are modeled
new onAtkWin gauge destruction/shared draw and onDefWinChar recovery are executed but not explicitly given their own future payoff in existing evalBattle
selection adapter is not a proof of optimal AI; primary effect is ability bundle under a specified fixed-profile policy
